name: Jordan
paragraphs: I enjoy playing guitar and worship music. I also enjoy working out, which I've done for years.
When I had nowhere else to go, Hope House Guthrie gave me shelter, a bed, food, and structure. What has meant the most to me is being around people who share my desire to stay clean.

I'm proud that I've found a job and become more open about sharing my life with others. I'm grateful to the people who support Hope House Guthrie. I don't know where I'd be without that support, but now I have some hope.
quote: I don’t know where I’d be, but now I have some hope.
